__comment: TEMPORARY TEXTURE. berlord asked for one face of Malum's soul stained steel block wrapped around the shaft until proper art exists. Malum is All Rights Reserved, so the texture is REFERENCED by path and resolved at runtime - no Malum pixel is shipped here - exactly as with Create's. That does mean Malum must be present or this renders as a missing texture; see README. Geometry is a plain 4x4x16 pole authored here. No tintindex: the texture is already the right colour, which is what lets Create's rotating renderer draw it correctly - that renderer bakes models with no tint handling at all, so a tinted shaft could never spin in the right colour.
